# Project instructions

## Frontend

- React + TypeScript.
- Use existing components whenever possible.
- Do not create a new component if an equivalent component already exists.
- Prefer existing SCSS styles and design tokens.
- Do not use inline styles unless absolutely necessary.
- Keep components small and reusable.
- Follow the existing project folder structure.
- Do not introduce a new UI library.
- Before creating a component, inspect existing components for reusable patterns.

## Figma implementation

When implementing a Figma design:

1. Use Figma MCP to inspect the design.
2. Identify existing components that correspond to Figma components.
3. Reuse existing React components.
4. Reuse existing SCSS classes and variables.
5. Only create new components when no suitable existing component exists.
6. Match spacing, typography, colors and dimensions from Figma.
7. Make the implementation responsive.
8. Do not replace the project's existing design system with generated CSS.
